name: async-vdot
title: Async VDOT — Video Direct Observation of Therapy
shortDescription: Patients record medication intake videos; clinicians review asynchronously. For MAT, TB DOTS, and adherence programs.
description:
Async VDOT brings Video Direct Observation of Therapy into your doxy.me workflow — asynchronously. Patients record short guided videos of themselves taking medication; clinicians review them on their own schedule in a structured queue.

Designed for:
• MAT (Medication-Assisted Treatment) programs — buprenorphine, methadone, naltrexone
• TB DOTS (Directly Observed Therapy, Short-course) programs
• General medication adherence monitoring for chronic conditions

Key Features:
• Patient self-recording with step-by-step guided medication intake flow
• Clinician review queue with approve/flag/request-retake workflow
• Adherence dashboard with 7-day trends, completion rates, and activity feed
• Patient roster with enrollment, medication schedules, and status tracking
• HIPAA-ready video storage with encrypted transmission

Built by doxy.me Labs. Integrated directly into your doxy.me session.
optionalDescription: Ideal for addiction medicine specialists, infectious disease clinicians, and primary care providers running structured medication adherence programs. No additional app downloads required for patients — record directly from the browser.
